desired_change.text: A custom inference engine for Meta Muse Spark Open exists that runs on NVIDIA DGX Spark.

quotes.text: Build a custom inference engine for Meta Muse Spark Open that runs on NVIDIA DGX Spark.

requested_result.text: The engine, judged against the attached target specification, delivered as a reproducible container with a clean rebuild, a benchmark report and replayable run artifacts.

quotes.text: The attached System Ontology files describe the model, the machine and the target the engine is judged on.
- {item: reproducible_container, resolution: required}
- {item: benchmark_report,       resolution: required}

context.name: Meta Muse Spark Open (model/muse-spark-open)
context.role: The given model the engine must run: 816B parameters in total, 42B active per token, 62 layers, a router selecting 8 of 256 experts per token per layer, vendor-stated context length of 1,000,000 tokens, text+image+video+audio input and text output, BF16 and NVFP4 weights in safetensors.

context.role: The given hardware the engine must run on: GB10 Grace Blackwell SoC with a 20-core arm64 CPU (cpu0) and a Blackwell GPU (gpu0).

uncertainties.description: The context length the engine must offer (a pass/fail requirement) is not given; the target notes the engine cannot be sized until it is, because attention state shares the 80 GB budget with the expert cache.

quotes.text: so the engine cannot be sized until this is given

uncertainties.description: The fixed workload used for measurement (prompt lengths and requests) is not defined, for the target as a whole and for TTFT, decode rate and peak memory.
uncertainties.clarification: What fixed workload (prompts and their lengths, output lengths, concurrency) are the measurements taken on?

quotes.text: workload: UNSET                # scope page: a fixed workload, not defined.

uncertainties.description: The held-out task set and the pass threshold for the quality requirement are not named.

uncertainties.description: Whether quantisation below NVFP4 or approximations that change output are allowed is not set; the quality comparison (identical tokens vs a task-score threshold) depends on it.

uncertainties.description: The scope page names three memory figures (128 GB nominal, 12 GB GPU working set, 80 GB); the target chose 80 GB, cited as 'Strata-Spark: 80 GB Unified Memory', as the budget. The choice is the target author's interpretation and the scope page is not supplied to check it.
uncertainties.clarification: Is 80 GB of the unified pool the memory budget the engine is judged on?

quotes.text: The scope page names three figures.
80 GB is the one figure that is a budget for this machine.

uncertainties.description: The model card states 700 GB of memory required at NVFP4, while the machine has 128 GB nominal unified memory and the proposed budget is 80 GB. This is a tension between a vendor statement and the given budget, not between two stated requirements; the sources do not say how it is to be resolved.
uncertainties.clarification: None needed from the user unless the budget or the machine changes; the engine design must address it.

readiness.reason: The requested work is clear: a custom inference engine for Meta Muse Spark Open on NVIDIA DGX Spark, judged on the attached target, delivered as a reproducible container with clean rebuild, benchmark report and replayable run artifacts. The open items are missing or proposed parameters (context length, workload, quality task set and threshold, allowed transformations, checkpoint, form, environment, streaming) and confirmation of proposals; none leaves the purpose unknown and no two stated requirements contradict each other, so none is blocking under the producer rules. Requirements must carry them as unresolved items.
